it('shouldinvoketheeventhandleronlyonce', function(){var$event,$sound;$rootScope.$once('ngOnce.sound', function(event, sound) { $event = event.name; $sound = sound; }); $rootScope.$broadcast('ngOnce.sound', 'boop'); $rootScope.$broadcast('ngOnce.sound', 'bang'); $rootScope.$broadcast('ngOnce.sound', 'pow'); expect($event).to.equal('ngOnce.sound'); expect($sound).to.equal('boop'); })
